Hope you’re well — sending invoice 4302 for July usage (attached). Our AP team is aiming to clear this by Aug 5, but we prefer ACH if possible (fewer fees on our side).

Can you confirm:

Also attaching our PO once procurement approves. If there’s anything missing on your invoice lines let me know and I’ll get procurement to add it.

SWIFT: FPACUS33
Bank address: 340 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94104
Account number: 00123456789
Please include: "Remit: Invoice 4302 / Lumin Labs PO 99821" in the reference field.

If your AP requires reverse charge handling or a EU/VAT-registered entity, we can route a VAT-compliant invoice from our EU billing entity — that will require confirming your VAT number and whether reverse charge applies. For speed, ACH to the US account will work; if procurement needs a VAT-bearing invoice we can reissue it (may add 2 business days).

If paying by card is easier for you, Ben is cc’d and can provide a one-time virtual card link and instructions.

Can you confirm: 1) remit-to email to CC on payment (ap@redwood.com is preferred) and 2) whether you want us to reissue the invoice with VAT fields for reverse charge?

Thanks — I’ll watch for the PO and confirmation.

Best,
Irene Choi

Redwood Inference
